queue.title: Reference checks
queue.subtitle: Verify past work that workers did outside KaamSathi. Call the reference, then record what you found.
queue.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting} one {# waiting} other {# waiting}}
queue.on_platform_hint: {name} is on KaamSathi and can confirm this from their account. You can still verify it yourself.
queue.empty_body: New work history with a reference phone number will appear here.
queue.identity_unverified: This worker's identity is not verified yet. Check it before trusting their history.
queue.note_hint: required unless verified — the worker sees it
queue.note_placeholder: e.g. Spoke to the head chef, confirmed 2022–2023 as line cook.
queue.note_required: Add a note so the worker knows what to fix.

script.title: Call script
script.intro: Namaste, may I speak to {reference}? I am calling from KaamSathi about {worker}.
script.role_dates: Were they a {role} from {from} to {to}? (Don't read the dates out first — ask them.)
script.rehire: Would you hire them again? Any reason they left?
script.close: Thank you. We only record whether the details were confirmed.
script.privacy: Never share the worker's phone, ID or wage with the reference.

confirm.description: These workers say they worked for you before. Confirming helps them get hired elsewhere; reject only if it isn't true.
confirm.empty_body: When a worker lists your organization as a past employer, it appears here.
confirm.reject_body: The entry will be marked as rejected and the worker will be told.
confirm.reject_note_placeholder: e.g. Worked here for 3 months, not 2 years.
confirm.privacy_note: You only see what the worker wrote. Their references and documents stay private.

match.interested_hint: This worker asked for this job in the app.

offer.title: Offer to {name}
offer.description: The worker gets the offer by SMS and in the app, and can accept or decline. You can still join them without an offer.
offer.expires_in_hint: After this the offer expires and you can send a new one.
offer.join_from_offer: Terms below are filled from the offer the worker accepted.
offer.join_without_offer: No accepted offer yet. You can still join them, but a written offer avoids wage disputes later.
